name: deployment-card
title: Deployment card
description: A build status card with an animated bar per step and details that fold out.

props.name: title
props.description: The name of the project, shown as the heading.

props.name: environment
props.description: The small line above the title, such as the environment name.

props.name: branch
props.description: The branch name, shown in monospace under the title.

props.name: commit
props.description: The commit id, shown after the branch.

props.name: message
props.description: The commit message, shown on one line under the branch.

props.name: steps
props.description: The steps to list, in order; each gets a status, a bar and optional details.

props.name: stateLabels
props.description: The text shown for each overall state in the header, with English defaults.

props.name: labels
props.description: Screen reader text for each step status, plus `progress`, the word added to each step's progress bar name.

props.name: actions
props.description: Buttons for the footer, aligned to the right. The footer is left out without them.

a11y.text: Each step is a button. A step without details is disabled; one with details toggles its details. The whole row is the click target, and the focus ring wraps the row.

The card is an article. The state chip has role status and its text comes from stateLabels. Each step button reads its label followed by its status in text (Pending, Running, Succeeded, Finished with warnings, Failed), set through labels. Each step's bar is a progressbar named after the step, with a value from 0 to 100. A step with details carries aria-expanded. The icons are aria-hidden.
The spin and ping animations and the colour and chevron transitions stop under reduced motion, and the rest uses Motion with reduced motion set to user.
